summary: First iteration testing of Loom (AI movie/TV discovery). Backend: 23/23 pytest passing across auth, discoveries (text/url/screenshot with Gemini AI + TMDB-mock enrichment), library CRUD with dedupe & filters, collections, and semantic search. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): register → home → add-discovery text mode → AI detected Inception+Interstellar with 100% confidence and posters → Save to library (dedupe indicator shown) → Done → Library tab shows item with filter chips → Movie detail screen renders with overview, cast, director, watch-status buttons, rating input, note, remove. All testIDs present and interactive. No React Native red screen, no deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch not used). App is production-quality for a first iteration.

issues: Console warns 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — web-only React-Native-Web warnings, cosmetic only, safe to ignore or migrate later

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Silence RN-Web deprecation warnings by migrating shadow* props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents in shared components — non-blocking.
Consider seeding the pre-declared demo@gmail.com/secret123 account on startup so it is guaranteed present (currently only mentioned in test_credentials.md — must be registered on first use).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~600 lines — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting routes (auth/discoveries/library/collections/search) into separate routers as it grows past 700.
get_current_user resolves session via db.user_sessions plus a users lookup on every protected request — fine for MVP; consider caching if traffic grows.
_used_google_session_ids is an in-process set; will not survive restarts and does not dedupe across replicas. OK for single-instance preview; document limitation.
MongoDB unique index on (user_id, tmdb_id, media_type) correctly enforces library dedupe at DB level — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (register, home, add-discovery text, AI detection, save to library, library list+filters, movie detail render)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Test users are created dynamically per-run with unique @gmail.com emails (prefixed test_/uitest_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://media-vault-api.preview.emergentagent.com. Use pytest override addopts='' to bypass -n xdist in pytest.ini (parallel workers break shared pytest.<name> module-state used to pass IDs between test classes). Run: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_loom_api.py -v -o 'addopts='`. Email validator rejects .test/.local — always use @gmail.com. Search & Profile tabs exist with data-testid='search-input','search-submit','search-result-*','profile-logout' — confirmed present in DOM but clicking bottom tab bar via text=Search failed in playwright due to duplicate hidden text nodes; use CSS selector on tab role or navigate via router.push URL for reliable navigation. AI pipeline responds in ~5-12s per text discovery.
